name: AE Staff
migrationPolicy: PHP/Blade code release with compiled assets committed in Git. Rehearse and move Staff separately from Public. Run artisan migrate --force only in a disposable builder, and only when database/migrations or composer.lock under apps/staff changed. Composer vendor is prepared only when apps/staff/composer.lock changes; otherwise reuse the cached layer. A Staff change must never rebuild Public or Mail.
rollbackPolicy: If reload or health fails, restore the previous current pointer, reload, and re-check container plus public HTTPS. Do not run down-migrations. Do not rebuild Public or Mail while rolling Staff back.
